mapper.select: SELECT pk_id, id, account_type, account_id, secret, status, enabled_at, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM account_mfa WHERE account_type = #{accountType} AND account_id = #{accountId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_mfa( id, account_type, account_id, secret, status, enabled_at, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{accountType}, #{accountId}, #{secret}, #{status}, #{enabledAt}, #{isDeleted}, #{gmtCreated}, #{gmtModified}, #{gmtDeleted} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE secret = VALUES(secret), status = VALUES(status), enabled_at = VALUES(enabled_at), is_deleted = 0, gmt_deleted = VALUES(gmt_deleted), gmt_modified = VALUES(gmt_modified)
